**Enemies:** for Chancellor/Citizens, enemies are Exiles, not fellow Imperial players. For Exiles and Citizens temporarily non-Imperial during the specified Campaigns, enemies are any other players. - Chancellor chooses which Imperial defending warbands die. Surviving warbands from sites return to Chancellor’s board; surviving Citizens’ board warbands stay on those Citizens’ boards.
